{{Quote|The capital city in the Empress Teta system is called Cinnagar. It's a major trading center.|[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]|audio=Cinnagar-DLOTS.flac|<ref name="Audio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Cinnagar''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and the location of its ruler's [[Iron Citadel|palace]]. Due to the sheer size of the city&mdash;it covered half the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]&mdash;the whole world was sometimes called Cinnagar. This was a place where the citizens could experience the sights and glamor of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] in the [[Core District/Legends|Core District]]. Many shops and restaurants in Cinnagar were based on a certain planet in the Core Worlds; for instance, the [[Alderaan Museum of Fine Arts]] featured many art displays, [[Coruscant Fashions]] sold the latest Core Worlds styles, and [[Club Corellia]] offered many different cuisines from around the Core Worlds as well as all-night dancing and entertainment.

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sargo VenHalgon]] lived in a palace there. The [[Great Library of Cinnagar/Legends|Great Library of Cinnagar]] also existed there by this time.<ref name="TR">{{LivingForce|The Replacements}}</ref>

==History==
===Dark times===
The City of Cinnagar was once controlled by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] secret society, who ruled with an iron fist. The rulers, [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]], executed any who opposed them. Cinnagar was attacked by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], in an attempt to bring [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] back to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. They let Ulic choose his path. He chose to stay. They left him with the Krath.
